snippet.title: Alice's Mom's Rescue
snippet.description:
Alice's Mom's Rescue is a platformer game, the giant raven has captured Alice's mother. Help Alice save her mom through 3 worlds and 25 levels!
Available on PC Windows & Linux, Dreamcast, Atari Falcon CT60, here https://orionsoft.itch.io/alicemomrescue
